summary: 54-year-old backcountry skier fully buried and killed in an avalanche on an east-facing slope below treeline near Cameron Pass.
location: Southeast end of South Diamond Peak, near Cameron Pass (~10,500 ft)
responding_agency: Jackson County Sheriff's Office; Jackson County Coroner; Colorado Avalanche Information Center
notes: Ralph Eberspacher, 54, of Fort Collins; avalanche warning in effect; slide 2-3 ft deep, 150 ft wide; first CO avalanche fatality of the 2021-22 season.
